name: Tidal
description: Downloads tracks and albums from your Tidal account in Hi-Res FLAC, FLAC or AAC 320, with tags, cover art and lyrics written into each file.

settings.label: Client ID
settings.help: Leave empty to use the built-in client (the one tiddl uses), which tops out at LOSSLESS. Enter your own Tidal API client ID for Hi-Res.

settings.label: Client secret
settings.help: Only if your own Client ID has a secret. Leave empty otherwise.

settings.label: Login URL
settings.help: Only for client IDs that log in through the browser: after pressing Test and signing in, paste the address of the page you land on here, save, and press Test again.

settings.label: Quality
settings.help: Type exactly one of: HI_RES_LOSSLESS (FLAC up to 24-bit/192 kHz), LOSSLESS (FLAC 16-bit/44.1 kHz) or HIGH (AAC 320). Empty means LOSSLESS; anything else fails the download. A track that lacks the quality comes in the best one it has.

settings.label: Country code
settings.help: Two-letter catalog country, like US. Empty uses your Tidal account's country.

settings.label: Cover size
settings.help: Type one of: 80, 160, 320, 640 or 1280 (pixels). Empty means 1280; other numbers snap to the nearest of these.
